title: Order No. 50-2026 — Special Order for Yellowfin Waste & Environmental, LLC, ex parte.
text:
Special Order No. 50-2026
Page 1
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
SPECIAL ORDER NUMBER 50-2026
YELLOWFIN WASTE & ENVIRONMENTAL, LLC
EX PARTE
In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC Nos. 8615 & 8618
On information and belief that the carrier wishes to close LPSC Nos. 8615 & 8618 per a notarized
affidavit received on July 7, 2026, it is therefore ORDERED that LPSC Nos. 8615 & 8618 held by
Yellowfin Waste & Environmental, LLC are hereby CANCELLED and REVOKED, with all
outstanding fees and fines owed the Commission to be paid by the carrier in the event of any
reinstatement.
(Decided July 8, 2026)
BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
July 8, 2026
BRANDON M. FREY
